verdict: P12B not shipped. OutputChain on master still treats limiterDb=0 as limiter bypass, not transparent safety. Sanitizer is honest; the unsafe runtime state is reached through the sanitizer's permissive default (limiterDb=0). With +10.73 dB master and chain gainB=2, the only full-scale protection is the 0.985->0.999 tanh soft ceiling, which pins output at 0.999 and produces the observed nearClipSamples spikes.

topFindings.title: Limiter structurally bypassed at default limiterDb=0
topFindings.evidence: Source/Core/DSP/Global/OutputChain.cpp:278 calls limiter.process(...) only inside isLimiterActiveDb(currentLimiterDb). isLimiterActiveDb(0.0f) returns false because the comparison is < -0.0001f. PluginProcessor.cpp:451 and PluginStateModel.h:306 both default the parameter to 0.0f, so the default-shipped state has the limiter off.

topFindings.title: Soft ceiling becomes de facto main limiter at default
topFindings.evidence: OutputChain.cpp:33-54 applySoftCeiling has threshold=0.985, ceiling=0.999, knee=0.014 (14 mdB). Logs show sustained peakLMax=0.999, exactly the ceiling constant. softCeilingTouchedSamples is high in alert windows when nearClipSamples is high.

topFindings.title: Sanitizer is permissive, not protective
topFindings.evidence: sanitizeOutputVolumeDb clamps to [-36, +12] (OutputChain.cpp:3-11). sanitizeLimiterDb clamps to [-12, 0] (OutputChain.cpp:13-21). +10.73 dB master and 0 dB limiter are both in range. There is no cross-check between master gain and limiter state.

topFindings.title: ChannelStrip allows +6 dB chain makeup
topFindings.evidence: ChannelStrip.cpp:5-11 sanitizeGain clamps to [0, 2] linear. Preset con master alto uses gainB=2 (max) plus widthB=0 (mono summing), driving ChannelStrip output close to 1.0 before OutputChain master gain is applied.

topFindings.title: SIGNAL_NEAR_CLIP_THRESHOLD sits below soft-ceiling ceiling
topFindings.evidence: Constants.h:112 SIGNAL_NEAR_CLIP_THRESHOLD=0.98 < softCeiling ceiling 0.999. Any soft-ceiling-engaged sample (>=0.985 in, ~0.999 out) increments nearClipSamples. High nearClipSamples is a consequence of soft ceiling becoming the main limiter, not a separate bug.

secondaryFindings.title: Latency reporting will desync if limiter becomes always-on
secondaryFindings.evidence: OutputChain.cpp:172-175 updateReportedLatencyForLimiter sets latency to limiter.getLookaheadSamples() only when isLimiterActiveDb(limiterDb). P12D must remove the branch.

secondaryFindings.title: UI naming oddity (not a bypass)
secondaryFindings.evidence: PluginEditor.cpp:3458-3459 attaches OUTPUT_LIMITER parameter to a slider named outputGain. The parameter binding is correct; sanitization still runs; this is a naming/labeling concern only.

secondaryFindings.title: Tests encode current (buggy) default
secondaryFindings.evidence: AudioEngineTests.cpp:3907, 4091, 4138, 4196, 4594 explicitly set outputLimiterDb = 0.0f. P12D must update these to expect always-on lookahead.

rejectedBypassHypotheses.reason: SessionStore.h, SessionPersistence.h, PluginStateModel.h all route through sanitizeFloatProperty / setProperty with default 0.0f. Sanitizer is invoked; it simply allows 0.0f.
SliderParameterAttachment targets the RangedAudioParameter, which constrains values to [-12, 0]. Sanitization runs on every push to runtime params cache.

rejectedBypassHypotheses.hypothesis: Race condition / stale target read on targetLimiterDb
rejectedBypassHypotheses.reason: OutputChain.cpp uses std::atomic<float> with sanitize on both store and read. No torn or stale value would produce sustained 0.999 across many windows.

exactSuspectedBypassPath: outputLimiterParam default 0.0f -> SessionStore runtimeParamsCache.outputLimiterDb=0.0f -> RuntimeGlobalParams snapshot.outputLimiterDb=0.0f -> AudioEngine pushes to OutputChain via setParams(vol, 0.0f) -> sanitizeLimiterDb(0.0f) returns 0.0f -> isLimiterActiveDb(0.0f) returns false -> processBlock skips limiter.process -> applyMasterGain applies +10.73 dB -> applyFinalSoftCeiling is the only ceiling and pins at 0.999 -> telemetry reports peakLMax=0.999 with nearClipSamples high.

must: Redefine limiterDb=0 as engaged transparent safety with threshold ~-0.3 dB linear (0.95..0.97) and slow release
updateReportedLatencyForLimiter: report limiter.getLookaheadSamples() unconditionally; remove the 0 vs lookahead branch
